messages:
eli: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands security segment — opening a thread for leftover SOC2/ISO/VPC/KMS/audit log questions. Keep Qs short and we'll route.

maria: Thanks eli. High-level: SOC2 readiness is our priority for Q3 audit intake; ISO is scoped but likely late-Q4 into next FY.

tanvi: For Private/VPC installs 1: do we support both AWS VPC peering and AWS Transit Gateway? Which is preferred for large customers?

greg: We support VPC peering and Transit Gateway. Recommendation: Transit Gateway for multi-account, high-throughput setups; peering is fine for single-account simple setups.

tanvi: Does peering require a support ticket or is it self-serve?

ops: Peering in the new private agent pipeline is self-serve but gated by a network verification step. Submit network CIDR + allowed ports and we'll auto-validate.

maria: KMS question from sales: can hosted customers bring their own key (BYOK) today? HSM?

eli: Hosted BYOK is not GA. We offer CMK/HSM for Dedicated and Private (enterprise tiers). Hosted BYOK (with HSM) is on roadmap; aim for an opt-in beta in Q4.

compliance-bot: Note: audit evidence bundle v0.3 will be published to the compliance channel on Thursday.

tanvi: Audit logs: defaults, retention, and export options?

ops: Default hosted retention = 90 days. Dedicated/Private can configure retention up to 365 days. Exports: syslog/S3/Splunk/Customer SIEM supported for Private. Example export snippet:```audit_export:
  enabled: true
  destination: s3://my-company-logs
  format: json
  retention_days: 365```

greg: Are request-level token counts in audit logs or only in billing metrics?

eli: Token counts are recorded in the billing/usage pipeline. Per-request verbose token logging is available as an opt-in feature for Dedicated/Private (audit-sensitive customers often enable it).

maria: For SOC2 we need org-level control narratives. Who's owning collection?

compliance-bot: Security will own the central control narratives and most infra artefacts. Teams must contribute team-specific artifacts (runbooks, training logs, access reviews). We'll publish a checklist.

tanvi: Will CMK rollout support key rotation without downtime?

eli: Plan is a double-write/dual-key transitional mode for rotation, with automatic fallback. No planned downtime, but rotation requires coordination for older cached sessions. We'll document the steps.

greg: Any update on encryption-at-rest for backups and snapshots?

ops: Backups for Dedicated/Private are encrypted with customer-managed keys when configured; hosted uses provider-managed keys by default. Snapshots in Hosted are encrypted and isolated per-tenant.

maria: Customers ask about FedRAMP and HIPAA. Quick answers?

eli: HIPAA support pattern: we offer BAA for Private/Dedicated in enterprise contracts, with controls required. FedRAMP: not pursuing this year.

compliance-bot: Action items logged: 1) ops -> publish VPC checklist; 2) compliance -> publish SOC2 evidence checklist; 3) product -> prepare customer-facing timeline for CMK beta.

tanvi: Thanks. Can you ping here when the VPC checklist is live?

ops: Will do. :white_check_mark:
